g.title: realization_axis
g.text: Realization × Certainty: goal → stages → workflows (one zone each) → judge → confidence gate

g.title: cluster_realization
g.text: Realization axis: where to cut (kind of thinking)

g.title: cluster_certainty
g.text: Certainty axis: what kind of cut (certainty.md as it stands, read per workflow)

g.title: cluster_confidence
g.text: Confidence: a separate judge call (confidence-judge.md); code applies the gate

g.title: cluster_remedies
g.text: Remedy along the axis the gap points to

g.title: cluster_example
g.text: Example grid: food delivery for 10,000 users (stage × workflow zone)

g.title: place
g.text: 2. Place each factor in the stage
whose kind of thinking owns it

g.title: workflows
g.text: goal · done-test · delivers (one per item) · informs
down to work atoms (one goal, one check)

g.title: rules
g.text: R1 every item: one delivering workflow · R2 single delivery
R3 one kind each · R4 earns place · R5 merge/split · R6 goal, done-test, method

g.title: stagezone
g.text: stage zone = least certain of its workflows
(derived by code, for the Map only)

g.title: checks
g.text: inputs · method · done_test · factors · zone_fit · size

g.title: propose
g.text: → Priority funds what passed (and at_risk only if it chooses)

g.title: notready
g.text: workflows that depend on it are held

g.title: r_research
g.text: world fact or no known method
in the stage that owns the question
